scope.monitoring_and_control: One registered simulated bus in local, explicitly configured profiles
scope.isolation_exercise: Two vehicles with distinct run identities and live, replay, and experiment permissions

excluded_claims: fleet outage recovery and queue capacity

gate_requirements.Q-01: Verify current one-bus scalar coverage in data intake, current readings, history, and the dashboard.
gate_requirements.Q-02: Account for every event in the selected runs and across independent service restarts. Require zero unexplained loss and no pending events after recovery.
gate_requirements.Q-03: Verify original readings survive disk-queue and service interruptions in the selected profile. Fleet payload-capacity measurement is deferred.
gate_requirements.Q-04: Retain the W0-30 display measurement. Verify affected browser paths after changes. Full-duration fleet display latency is deferred.
gate_requirements.Q-05: Use compatible sealed history data to verify the current history path against existing query limits.
gate_requirements.Q-06: Verify freshness and resumed, disconnected, and paused states using existing limits.
gate_requirements.Q-07: Verify selected recovery cases and preserve compatible real five-minute single-bus recovery evidence. Fleet outage drain qualification is deferred.
gate_requirements.Q-08: Verify no repeated effect after duplicate handoff or restart, including unresolved outcomes, using independent simulated effect evidence.
gate_requirements.Q-09: Verify access and actuation isolation across scoped roles, assets, and run modes.
gate_requirements.Q-10: Verify the selected local restore path, permission equivalence, and existing restore limits with compatible evidence.
gate_requirements.Q-11: Verify selected local startup readiness with available images under the existing limit and document the clean-start workflow.
gate_requirements.Q-12: Keep the current launch and runtime resource guards for live checks. Retain W0-30 results. Fleet resource and endurance qualification is deferred.

additional_release_checks: Supported upgrade and explicit incompatibility checks
Two-asset live, replay, and experiment isolation
Local retention preview and affected storage safeguards
Current dashboard and packaged demo checks
Source, package, and Git history privacy and rights review
